android.desc:
Important: we suggest you install the main Open Food Facts app instead, which now has petfood support.

Scan pet food products or their barcode to obtain data on ingredients, additives and nutrition facts.

The app allows to view the over 10000 pet products already contained in the free and open database Open Pet Food Facts, and also to add pictures and data for missing products.

Let's collect information on all the pet food in the world
To discover the Open Pet Food Facts project, please visit https://world.openpetfoodfacts.org

You will also be able to find (according to the indications present on the products):
- nutritional info, nutrition traffic lights…
- brands, allergens, labels (organic, vegan...)

You can scan dog food (dry dog food and wet dog food), cat food, rabbit food, snake food, fish food, bird food, or any food for your favorite animal.

quotes.text:
The android app is now live: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=org.openpetfoodfacts.scanner

As is the website: https://world.openpetfoodfacts.org

lthough Open Food Facts went from 100k to 300k products in just a few months, indexing all the food in the world proves to be a sizeable challenge: there are still millions of products not yet indexed all over the world.

As a result, we decided to focus on a task easier to achieve: Pet Food. And while we love all pets equally, in order to make our objective reachable, we have to focus only on one kind of pet: dogs, or cats or birds, etc.

But the good news is that you get to decide which pet that is, by participating in our worldwide competition:

1 New Pet Food uploaded to Open Pet Food Facts = 1 Vote for the Pet Food type of your choice
quotes.story_title: Introducing OpenPetFoodFacts, the Wikipedia for Pet Food (for iOS,Android and Web)
